description: List pi sessions held by this server, running and finished, plus finished durable sessions stored on disk (`stored`). Up to 50 finished sessions stay loaded; status/wait read stored results without loading, and follow_up loads the conversation. Stored sessions expire by retention. Pass cwd to find this project's history; entries include remainingTurns and state/budget canFollowUp.

cwd.description: Absolute project directory; includes loaded and stored sessions for this cwd

state.description: Filter by state: starting, running, done, aborted, error

verbose.description: Include full text and tool calls

name: sessions
